note.windows: The first build takes 5 to 15 minutes and about 1 GB. Python, CMake and the Visual Studio Build Tools (about 2 GB) are installed if they are missing; Windows asks for permission once. Works with GOG's Complete Collection (installed, or its offline installer) and the DOS release.
note.default: The first build takes 5 to 15 minutes and about 1 GB. It needs gcc, CMake, Python 3 and SDL2's development files (and innoextract for GOG's installer) from your package manager; if any are missing it says which, with the command to install them. Works with GOG's Complete Collection and the DOS release.
